answer: An attacker must acquire and lock real value per fake identity, making mass fabrication costlier than honest participation, like harvesting scattered quartz across an ocean of accounts rather than one deep deposit. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity binding: each agent locks a bond of quartz-backed tokens to register, and voting weight decays to a nadir if the bond is slashed for duplicate-identity proofs. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
